name: agent-guidance
description: Dev-only tooling deps. This repo is bash+yq; the single dependency below backs scripts/check-cron-coverage.js, which must parse workflow YAML with a real parser rather than a line scanner (house rule: AST/parser always for anything reasoning about code structure). Pinned exactly, and to the same 2.9.0 cms-platform's e2e lint suite already resolves, so the two trees cannot disagree about what a workflow means.
